The present application under Section 439 read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 248/2019, under Section 376/120-B of the IPC, registered at P.S. Darya Ganj.
2.
The status report is handed in Court today and the same is taken on record.

The case of the prosecutrix as per the status report authored by Insp. Harjinder Rana is as under:
"Most respectfully it is showeth that on 17.12.19, the above case was registered on the statement of prosecutrix "M", Age- 23 years."
Victim stated that she has been working in a showroom of Deep Hyundai.

She has become friend with applicant,
age-25 years around 1 year ago and physical relation developed between them twice with her consent in May, 2019.
In Oct 2019, their friendship was ended.
But they used to have occasional conversion on phone.
She met with Salman and Tasleem through Shadab in May, 2019.
On 16.12.19, Salman called her through phone and invited her to his birthday party Jama Masjid.
She reached at Jama Masjid metro station and found Salman and his friend Tasleem there.
After that Shadab joined them and they went to lirty:i Guest House, Darya Ganj to celebrate birthday Party.
They offered chicken and wine.
She was intoxicated due to consumption of wine.
She went to bathroom and Shadab followed her.
Shadab kissed her and made physical relation with her forcefully.

3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the applicant and the prosecutrix were in a consensual relationship which has been admitted by the latter in the FIR.
It is further stated that the alleged incident took place on 16.12.2019, i.e., after a breakup between them.
The proxecutrix/complainant, who is present in the Court today and has been identified by the Investigating Officer, submits that she has no objection if the present application is allowed.
4. The applicant has been in judicial custody since 22.07.2022.
Charge- sheet has been filed and the matter is fixed for consideration on charge before the learned trial Court.
5. In view of the facts and circumstances, the present application is allowed.

The present applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court/Link Court, further subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the learned trial Court.
ii. The applicant shall intimate the learned trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the learned trial Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
iv. The applicant shall join investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer concerned.
v. The applicant shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer and intimate about any change.
6. The application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
7. Order be uploaded on the website of this court forthwith.
8. Needless to state, nothing mentioned hereinabove is an opinion on the merits of the case.
9. Copy of this order be sent to concerned Jail Superintendent for necessary information and compliance.
